component.name: Battery Health Center
component.summary: Battery health, charge limits and app energy usage in one place
Akkuzustand, Ladelimits und Energieverbrauch der Anwendungen an einem Ort
Salud de la batería, límites de carga y consumo de energía de las aplicaciones en un solo lugar

description.p: Battery Health Center brings everything about your laptop battery together in one native GNOME app.

ul.li: Charge level, time remaining, power draw and charger wattage
Maximum capacity, condition, cycle count, and capacity over time with a projection
Set a maximum charge level or pick a charge profile to extend your battery's lifespan, or charge to 100% once
A charging schedule and optimized charging: full just before you need the laptop, your limit the rest of the time
Battery level and power draw history, and battery use during sleep
Apps using the most energy, now and over the last 7 days, with an hour-by-hour view for each app
Wireless device batteries, notifications, guided calibration, a battery report and CSV export of your history
Power mode, automatic power mode and GNOME's power-saving settings in one place, plus battery-saving tips
Available in English, Spanish and German

description.p: After an upgrade, the hidden background copy now restarts itself on the new version, so the app no longer opens as the old version until you log out and in.
Maintenance release: removes the code that only existed for the snap package, which is no longer distributed. Install and update through the apt repository.
Clearer labels: the Power page row is now "Current Mode", the low-battery notification level is "Notify At", and "Charging Mode" on the Charging page is now "Charging Behavior".

ul.li: Charge profiles: Maximum Lifespan (60%), Balanced (80%) and Full Capacity (100%)
A charging schedule and optimized charging, which learns when you usually unplug
Click an app on the Usage page to see its energy use hour by hour
Export your history as CSV files from the menu
Battery-saving tips: lower a bright screen, turn off the keyboard backlight or an idle Bluetooth adapter

description.p: Fixes a crash when changing Screen Blank or Automatic Suspend on the Power page.
The charge ring now says "Not Charging" instead of a longer phrase that didn't fit.
Fixes the Power Mode dropdown, which undid your choice a moment after you made it.
Dropdowns on the Power page now ignore selections that change nothing.

ul.li: Automatic power mode: switches the power mode when you plug in or unplug, or when the charge gets low
GNOME's power-saving settings in one place: dim screen, screen blank, automatic suspend and brightness
Power button and lid actions, and the battery percentage in the top bar

description.p: Fixed: Overview showed a wrong unplug time when the app wasn't running as the charger came out.

ul.li: Charge to 100% Now: a one-time full charge, then your limit comes back
Since last charge, charger type and wattage, and battery use during sleep
Power draw chart, and capacity over time with a projected 80% date
Notifications for your charge limit, low battery, app drain and sleep drain
Wireless device batteries, app energy use over 24 hours or 7 days
Guided calibration, battery report export, and two-battery laptops

description.p: "Keep After Restart" is now on by default, so a charge limit that is already active gets saved when you click Apply.
